name: ai-memory
description: Gives coding agents self-hosted shared memory and handoffs, so work carries across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other harnesses, machines, and teammates.

skills.name: Cross-Agent Handoffs
skills.description: Passes the next agent a typed handoff, claimed exactly once, saying where work stopped, what failed, and what is still open.

skills.name: Session Capture
skills.description: Records prompts, tool calls, and session boundaries through lifecycle hooks and sanitizes them before anything is stored.

skills.name: Markdown Wiki Memory
skills.description: Consolidates sessions into git-versioned markdown wiki pages that stay the source of truth.

skills.name: Memory Search
skills.description: Searches full-text, entities, links, and optional vectors fused into one ranking.

skills.name: Memory Aging
skills.description: Decays unused memory on a tunable schedule and can compact cold notes to durable facts, with zero LLM calls.
